heading: Laws applicable
lead: The general provisions of sections 182 to 184, 185 to 188, 189 to 192, 193, and 194 1 of this title, are made applicable to permits and leases under this subchapter.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: Section 194 of this title, referred to in text, was repealed by Pub. L. 89–554, § 8(a), Sept. 6, 1966, 80 Stat. 644.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Provision of this section that section 193 of this title was amended to include deposits of potassium was omitted from this section as executed to section 193 of this title. Section was not enacted as part of act Feb. 25, 1920, ch. 85, 41 Stat. 437, known as the Mineral Leasing Act, which comprises this chapter.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1946—Act Aug. 8, 1946, struck out reference to section 181 of this title.

notes.heading: Savings Provision
notes.text: See note set out under section 181 of this title.
